# Windows endpoint investigation

Recorded results from the Cyber Range investigation reviewed November 14, 2026. Ten KQL queries produced a 233-record timeline. Private identifiers are omitted. The charts use elapsed minutes from the start of the investigation window.

content.title: Records by source
content.query:
datatable(Source:string, Records:long) [
"DeviceEvents", 100,
"DeviceFileEvents", 27,
"DeviceNetworkEvents", 6,
"DeviceProcessEvents", 43,
"DeviceRegistryEvents", 57
]
| order by Records desc, Source asc

content.query:

content.json:
## Investigation notes

Account creation and a registry write had supporting events. Task and service commands still need confirmation of the resulting state. An alert linked another endpoint; further evidence is needed to establish movement.

Query results can overlap. Earlier authentication activity was recovered in a separate, wider query. These panels display saved counts and remain unchanged when new telemetry arrives.
